defects.what: A comic speech bubble reading 'HEXV' sits left of the mother's face, and the shop signs on both sides carry pseudo-text.
Glowing shop signs along both sides of the rainy street, and their reflections, are full of pseudo-text glyphs.
defects.rejected: the shop signs are coloured light blurs; no glyph can be read at phone size, nothing written is visible in the video

defects.what: The young man facing the mother in the opening shot has no topknot and wears a blue button shirt and dark trousers, so he does not read as Indio.
A small handwritten scribble floats in the air beside the woman's head, just above the sea.
The top of the hologram panel shows rows of pseudo-text glyphs instead of a clean 80 percent readout.
Indio has full sleeve tattoos on both forearms, which he does not have anywhere else.
Indio's left forearm, the one holding the hologram, is covered in a sleeve tattoo.
The open picture book in the grandmother's lap has a scribbled pseudo-text heading and text lines.
A second, look-alike woman in white sits in the right window behind the mother, so the one seated woman seems drawn twice.
The black dog at bottom left has no red kerchief, no white chest patch and two folded ears, so it does not read as Usman.
Usman has both ears standing upright instead of one folded ear.
In this close-up, Usman has both ears tall and upright instead of one folded ear.
In this front close-up, Usman has both ears upright instead of one folded ear.
The large hand pressed to the glowing barrier in the foreground has only three fingers plus a thumb.
The arms in the hug are tangled: two red wrist cuffs and a spare hand on the mother's shoulder make it unclear whose arm is whose.
